liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **All Along The Watchtower** (3 reviews): Jerry plays with abandon on this one; Reviewer singles out this song as a favorite, along with Big Boss Man [9][13][15]
- **Big Boss Man** (2 reviews): Opening with this song was a surprise to the reviewer; Reviewer finds the opener well received by the crowd but musically weak [9][11]
- **Promised Land** (1 review): Reviewer considers it a more worthy opener than Big Boss Man [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd87-08-20 t01 Addams Family Tuning**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd87-08-20 t02 Big Boss Man**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd87-08-20 t03 Promised Land**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd87-08-20 t04 Dire Wolf**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd87-08-20 t05 New Minglewood Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd87-08-20 t06 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd87-08-20 t07 It's All Over Now**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]
- **gd87-08-20 t08 Loser**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-08-20.142156.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 163 min [1]
- **gd1987-08-20.151082.fm.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: FM broadcast; 23 songs; 160 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [4]
- **gd87-08-20.aud.ladner.8373.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 24 songs; 164 min; rated 3.33/5 by 15 [6]. Said about its sound: Crisp, clean, wide-spectrum audience recording, with some intrusive crowd noise; reviewer wonders if mountain air helps; Good sound overall; the start is rough but clears up as the tape goes on [9][10]
- **gd1987-08-20.unk.mjallen.106078.flac16**: source not stated; 14 songs; 84 min; rated 3.2/5 by 5 [8]. Said about its sound: Second set on cassette since 1988 sounds like a soundboard version; the full show in soundboard is unknown [20]

## Around the show

- Opening stretch has long random noodling and tuning, including a odd bass noise, before the Addams Family theme [11]
- Attendee describes the whole mountainside covered with people, from the stage base up beyond sight [12]
- Attendee recalls a fan known as the Turtle man, who blew through a tube into a turtle shell [13]
- Attendee describes Park West as an intimate, out-of-the-way venue and got pizza from behind the soundboard [15]
- Attendee won tickets from a Rock Springs radio station, arrived late, and found the night chilly, with Bob in shorts [16]
- Attendee recalls a late-summer afternoon on the mountainside, with mounted police chasing fans who hiked around the unfenced back [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-08-20.142156.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC3/MK41mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]. Also: Master recordings by the Oade brothers and crew, transferred to hard disk, with Schoeps microphones listed in the filename [1]
- **gd1987-08-20.151082.fm.hessberg.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Michael Hessberg; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Michael Hessberg's In-House FM master cassettes; unknown receiver > Sony D5M [4]
- **gd87-08-20.aud.ladner.8373.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD(unk. mic's) > DAT > CDR [6]. Also: Attendee got an audio cassette copy a week after the show; it later degraded and was lost [12]
- **gd1987-08-20.unk.mjallen.106078.flac16**: source: unknown [8]. Also: Second-set source has no lineage information and may be a circulated bootleg [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-08-20 Park West Ski Resort, Park City, UT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-08-20-park-west-ski-resort-park-city-ut-usa/) [22]
- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-08-20 Park West Ski Resort, Park City, UT, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-08-20-park-west-ski-resort-park-city-ut-usa/) [23]
